streamlit_config_toml:
[theme]
primaryColor = "#38BDF8"
backgroundColor = "#0B0F17"
secondaryBackgroundColor = "#131B2A"
textColor = "#F8FAFC"
font = "sans-serif"

[theme.sidebar]
backgroundColor = "#0D131F"
textColor = "#F8FAFC"

badge_styles.sql_badge: background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15); color: #38BDF8; border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;
badge_styles.python_badge: background: rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.15); color: #818CF8; border: 1px solid rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.3); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;
badge_styles.valid_badge: background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15); color: #34D399; border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.3); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;
badge_styles.warning_badge: background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.15); color: #FBBF24; border: 1px solid rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.3); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;

chat_bubble_styling.user_message: background: #1E293B; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 12px 12px 2px 12px; padding: 14px 18px; color: #F8FAFC; margin-bottom: 12px;
chat_bubble_styling.assistant_message: background: #0F172A; border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25); border-radius: 12px 12px 12px 2px; padding: 16px 20px; color: #F8FAFC; margin-bottom: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);

css_overrides_st_markdown:
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');

html, body, [class*="css"] {
  font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
  color: #F8FAFC;
}

.stApp {
  background-color: #0B0F17;
}

[data-testid="stSidebar"] {
  background-color: #0D131F;
  border-right: 1px solid #1E293B;
}

code, pre, [data-testid="stCodeBlock"] {
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace !important;
}

.stMetric {
  background: #131B2A;
  border: 1px solid #1E293B;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
}

.stButton > button {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0284C7 0%, #38BDF8 100%);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.stButton > button:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0369A1 0%, #0284C7 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
  color: #FFFFFF;
}
</style>
testing_attributes: All key containers, buttons, model selectors, query inputs, metrics, tables, and badge elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='dataset-upload-input', data-testid='model-selector-dropdown', data-testid='query-submit-button', data-testid='generated-sql-code', data-testid='guardrail-status-badge').

image_urls.description: Code display monitor for technical dark mode banner

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.

Use Plotly dark template matching #131B2A paper background for all generated figures.
